title: Targeted ExSeq - Sequencing Library Preparation
author: Anubhav Sinha
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgp7jvrn
materials: Wash buffer: 2X SSC, 20% formamide (v/v) in water
Wash-10 buffer: 2X SSC, 10% formamide (v/v) in water

Stripping solution: 80% formamide (v/v), 0.01% Triton X-100 (v/v) in water Suggested volumes to prepare: >10 mL. All buffers can be stored at Room temperature . Wash buffer should be used within one month of preparation.

Stripping Detection Oligo Transfer the gel from the imaging plate to an appropriate smaller container, i.e. PCR tube or microcentrifuge tube. Heat an appropriate amount of stripping solution to 80 °C . The stripping solution can be heated in a thermocycler. The total volume pre-heated should be enough for three full washes, i.e. 600 μL for gels in PCR tubes. Wash the sample with pre-heated stripping solution for 00:10:00, x 3 times . For each wash, use pre-heated stripping solution, but keep the sample at Room temperature .

Common Stock Solutions 1. 1X PBS 2. 2X SSC (Saline-Sodium Citrate) buffer 3. Wash buffer: 2X SSC, 20% formamide (v/v) in water 4. Wash-10 buffer: 2X SSC, 10% formamide (v/v) in water 5. Stripping solution: 80% formamide (v/v), 0.01% Triton X-100 (v/v) in water Suggested volumes to prepare: >10 mL. All buffers can be stored at Room temperature . Wash buffer should be used within one month of preparation.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Stocks
steps.instruction: Prepare and store the following stock solutions:

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 100 μL aliquot of 4 mM aminoallyl dUTP (aadUTP) and store at -20 °C.

Prepare 250 mM BS(PEG)9: Warm vial to room temperature, add 465 µL anhydrous DMSO, vortex, and aliquot ~20 µL into PCR tubes. Store at -20 °C in a Parafilm-sealed 50 mL tube containing Drierite (use within one month).
Prepare 100 µM RCA Primer (TCT TCA GCG TTC CCG A*G*A): Resuspend lyophilized DNA in water, prepare a ~100 µL working stock, and store at -20 °C.
Prepare Pooled Padlock Probes: Pool probes such that each individual probe concentration is equal and total concentration is maximized (typically 200 µM).
Prepare 100 µM Amplicon Detection Oligonucleotide Probe (/5Cy3/TCTCGGGAACGCTGAAGA): Resuspend lyophilized DNA in water, prepare a ~25 µL working stock, and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Sample Preparation and Scaling
steps.instruction: Ensure samples are prepared per Targeted ExSeq Tissue Preparation protocol (thickness <350 µm, trimmed/cut gels stored in 1X PBS).

substeps.instruction: For samples in PCR tubes: Use 200 µL volumes for washes; non-wash steps can be scaled down to 50-100 µL if gel is submerged.
For samples in microcentrifuge tubes: Scale recipes up to 400-600 µL to submerge gel; use 500-1000 µL for washes.

steps.title: Padlock Probe Hybridization
steps.instruction: Hybridize padlock probes to RNA transcripts within the expanded samples.

substeps.instruction: Pre-hybridize gels by washing with wash buffer for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Prepare hybridization buffer: 2X SSC, 20% formamide, and pooled padlock probes (suggested starting point: 100 nM per probe).
Incubate gels with hybridization mix overnight at 37 °C.
Wash gels with wash buffer for 30 minutes, 3 times at 37 °C (increase to 4-5 washes for libraries >100 uM final total probe concentration).
Wash gels with 1X PBS for 30 minutes at 37 °C.

steps.title: Enzymatic Ligation of Padlock Probes
steps.instruction: Ligate hybridized padlock probes using SplintR Ligase to form circular DNA.

substeps.instruction: Wash gels with 1X SplintR Ligase Buffer for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Prepare ligation mix at 4 °C (on ice/cold block) and incubate gels with pre-ligation mix for 6 hours at 4 °C (can be shortened to 3 hours or extended overnight).
Prepare a fresh volume of ligation mix and incubate gels for 6 hours at 37 °C (can be extended overnight).
Terminate ligation by washing gels with 2X SSC buffer for 30 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: RCA Primer Hybridization
steps.instruction: Hybridize the universal RCA primer to the padlock probe backbone.

substeps.instruction: Pre-hybridize gels by washing with wash buffer for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Prepare RCA primer hybridization mix by diluting 100 µM RCA primer stock 1:200 in wash buffer (500 nM final).
Incubate gels in hybridization mix for 2 hours at 37 °C (can be extended overnight).
Wash gels with wash buffer for 30 minutes at 37 °C.
Wash gels with 1X PBS for 15 minutes at 37 °C.

steps.title: Rolling Circle Amplification (RCA)
steps.instruction: Amplify ligated padlock probes using Phi29 DNA Polymerase, incorporating aadUTP.

substeps.instruction: Wash gels with 1X Phi29 Buffer for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Prepare pre-amplification mix at 4 °C and incubate gels for 6 hours at 4 °C (can be shortened to 3 hours or extended overnight).
Prepare RCA mix at 4 °C: 171 µL Water, 20 µL 10X Phi29 Buffer, 5 µL 10 mM dNTPs (250 µM final), 2 µL 4 mM aadUTP (40 µM final), and 2 µL 100 U/µL Phi29 DNA Polymerase (1 U/µL final).
Incubate gels with RCA mix overnight at 30 °C.
Terminate RCA by washing with 1X PBS for 30 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: BS(PEG)9 Cross-Linking
steps.instruction: Covalently anchor amplicons to themselves using BS(PEG)9.

substeps.instruction: Thaw one aliquot of reconstituted 250 mM BS(PEG)9 at room temperature and prepare crosslinking mix.
Incubate gels with crosslinking mix for 2 hours at room temperature.
Quench reaction by washing gels with 1 M Tris pH 8 for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Wash gels with 1X PBS for 30 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Optional Long Term Storage
steps.instruction: Store stable amplicons for future use.

substeps.instruction: Replace 1X PBS solution and store gels in well-sealed containers at 4 °C for up to several months.

steps.title: Amplicon Detection and Imaging
steps.instruction: Visualize amplicons using a fluorophore-labeled oligonucleotide probe.

substeps.instruction: Wash gels with Wash-10 buffer for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Prepare detection probe mix by diluting 100 µM amplicon detection probe stock 1:1000 in Wash-10 buffer (100 nM final).
Incubate gels in detection probe solution for 1 hour at 37 °C.
Wash gels with Wash-10 buffer for 20 minutes at 37 °C.
Wash gels with 1X PBS for 20 minutes at 37 °C.
Remove excess PBS and transfer gel to a glass-bottom 6-well or 24-well plate using a clean paintbrush.
Image using appropriate objectives (e.g., Nikon 40X LWD Water Immersion, NA 1.15).
Wash gels with 1X PBS for 10 minutes, 2 times at room temperature, then store as described in storage step.
Stain gels with DAPI in 1X PBS for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Wash with 1X PBS for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Remove 1X PBS thoroughly to prevent gel movement during imaging.
